description: On a new MDB database, ADO (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0) creates D(ID INTEGER primary key, N DECIMAL(28,0), S DECIMAL(18,4)). Then N and S are read from TableDefs (Type, Size, Attributes, and Properties Precision and Scale where present). Seven rows are written by DAO Database.Execute of INSERT statements with the values as SQL numeric literals: N = 7, 4294967296, 4294967301, 18446744073709551621, 79228162514264337593543950335, -7, 0; S = 1.5, 0.0001, -2.5, 12345678901234.5678, 0, -0.0001, 3.125. Then, after closing and reopening, asks what DAO Field.Value, SQL CStr(N), CStr(S) and CDbl(N), DAO equality and range filters on N and S, SUM/MAX/MIN of N, ADO Field.Value and ADO GetRows return for those rows.
retentionNote: Designed r-dec-read probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
